title: Bind correct SDR/HDR volume pipelines per render target (fix VUID 08910)
rationale: Validation shows vkCmdDraw format mismatch (R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT target bound with pipeline created for B8G8R8A8_SRGB). This indicates the SDR pipeline is being bound when rendering to the HDR TAA target.

edits.action: Explicitly bind m_volumePipelineHDR (not m_volumePipeline) before drawing to m_taaCurrentImage. Add a one-time debug log printing the chosen pipeline handle and the HDR format (VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT).

Ensure that the SDR pipeline (m_volumePipeline) is bound only when the active color attachment is a swapchain image. Optionally add a one-time debug log printing the pipeline handle and swapchain format.

instrumentation: Print [PIPE] volume-HDR or volume-SDR with pipeline handle and pColorAttachmentFormats[0] at bind time
Optional: assert that when drawing to TAA current, bound pipeline == m_volumePipelineHDR
acceptance: No VUID 08910 for the entire frame
Logs show HDR pipeline bound in renderToTAATarget and SDR pipeline bound for swapchain rendering
